metadata.description: Median household income for white, non-Hispanic householders (ACS table B19013H), on the same scale as the Black-household style. Measured over all 29,708 ZIP Code Tabulation Areas with a published value: 6 classes with breaks at $50k/$65k/$80k/$100k/$130k, which fall at the 10th/32nd/57th/78th/92nd percentile of the national distribution. Same breaks, ramp and opacity rule as the Black-household style — neither fades its noisy estimates, because fading only one of the pair would make the gap look like a difference in confidence. 12.08% have no published value and draw in neutral gray rather than as a low value. 11.05% of ZIP Code Tabulation Areas have a coefficient of variation above 0.3; this style does not fade them, so read median_hh_income_white_nh_moe in the GeoParquet before drawing a conclusion from any single ZCTA.
